note: D4 of the Shio Guard build plan. Counsel approves this file by recording who approved it and when in approved_by; until then every check prints that the policy is unapproved. Each new dependency still needs counsel's confirmation.

core.why: The build plan: MIT and Apache-2.0 only in the core, which itself ships as MIT OR Apache-2.0.

extras.why: Optional extras (shio-lang[...]) may also use these permissive licences. Anything else needs counsel.

exceptions.reason: required by pydantic, the core's only direct dependency; PSF-2.0 is permissive

pulled in by httpx for the [agt] extra (Microsoft Agent Governance Toolkit); a CA certificate bundle used unmodified. MPL-2.0 is file-level copyleft: it only obliges sharing changes to certifi's own files
